DGX OS Software The DGX B200 system comes pre-installed with a DGX software stack incorporating the following components: ▶ An Ubuntu server distribution using the optimized Linux kernel with supporting packages ▶ The following system management and monitoring software: ▶ NVIDIA System Management (NVSM) Provides active health monitoring and system alerts for NVIDIA DGX nodes in a data center. It also provides simple commands for checking the health of the DGX B200 system from the command line. ▶ Data Center GPU Management (DCGM) This software enables node-wide administration of GPUs and can be used for cluster and data-center level management. ▶ DGX B200 system support packages ▶ The NVIDIA GPU driver, including NVIDIA CUDA
